ex.en: My dad gives me an allowance of $10 a week.
ex.zh: 我爸每週給我 10 元零用錢。

ex.en: My dad gives me a weekly allowance that I use to buy comics and ice cream.
ex.zh: 我爸每週給我零用錢，我拿來買漫畫和冰淇淋。

ex.en: The duty-free allowance for alcohol is one liter.
ex.zh: 酒類的免稅額度是一公升。

ex.en: Check the baggage allowance before you pack.
ex.zh: 打包前先確認行李限額。

ex.en: Employees receive a travel allowance for business trips.
ex.zh: 員工出差可以領差旅津貼。

ex.en: The company pays a monthly housing allowance.
ex.zh: 公司每月發放住房津貼。

ex.en: The allocation of funds will be decided next week.
ex.zh: 經費的分配將在下週決定。

ex.en: Each team gets an equal allocation of time.
ex.zh: 每個團隊分到的時間一樣多。

ex.en: We need to allocate more resources to this project.
ex.zh: 我們需要為這個專案分配更多資源。

ex.en: The city allocated two million dollars for the new park.
ex.zh: 市政府撥了兩百萬元興建新公園。
